enrichment.summary: The district is approving a memorandum of understanding and engagement policy and a data services agreement with the law firm Fagen, Friedman & Fulfrost LLP. The firm will provide legal services on facilities and construction law matters as needed, except facilities or construction-related claims and litigation defense. The cap is $350,000 in a fiscal year, for March 1, 2024 through June 30, 2026. The data agreement sets rules for sharing and protecting student data with the firm.
